events.title: Cap separation during handling
events.summary: The working history records dirt at the seam and easy cap separation around mid-January. Stronger tape and a larger bond area become proposed responses. Credit: Shared team history.
events.date_basis: Document/report/message or stated event date, distinguished in limits; never filesystem/capture date.

events.title: Cap location changes
events.summary: The filename-dated EVT2 report narrows positioning holes and relocates cap alignment features near the dimmer. These changes are distinct from the later adhesive-pocket investigation. Credit: Shared engineering-change report.

events.title: Polish target and tool marks
events.summary: The filename-dated record shows tooling marks; the separate polish-area note defines a preliminary surface target subject to approval. Credit: Unsigned March records.

events.title: Incoming parts receive distinct dispositions
events.summary: Key and front-housing entries receive waivers; the cap entry combines a cosmetic waiver with sorting for a feature defect. These decisions do not prove a corrected later lot. Credit: Incoming inspection record; Yvonne Lai and IQC.
events.date_basis: Date precision and source state retained from the reviewed research chronology.

events.title: Revised tape fails crush test
events.summary: The revised pressure-sensitive adhesive still fails the recorded crush test. Credit: FIH.
events.date_basis: Document/report/message or stated event date, distinguished in limits; never filesystem/capture date.

events.title: Tool-correction samples received
events.summary: The working synopsis records revised samples around April 20 after a 0.1 mm adhesive-pocket mismatch and tooling correction. Credit: Shared tooling history.
events.date_basis: Document/report/message or stated event date, distinguished in limits; never filesystem/capture date.

events.title: Cavity-specific polish feedback
events.summary: Erik identifies uneven polish, stress marks and dents by mold cavity so the supplier can locate the tooling problems. Credit: Erik Norris, Locoroll.

events.title: Glued samples and remaining controls
events.summary: The action review keeps the cap issue under DVT monitoring as FIH develops the assembly process. Successful samples do not settle fixture and gap-inspection control. Credit: FIH and Locoroll.

events.title: Cap bonding operation specified
events.summary: The SOP defines FC1682 dispensing, separate placement and clamping fixtures, and a hold of at least five hours. Credit: FIH.

events.title: Key-life report retains overall FAIL
events.summary: Report date, test window July4-11; functional/visual PASS does not erase overall FAIL. Credit: FIH report; Laurence Liu/Sunny Yen.
events.date_basis: Document/report/message or stated event date, distinguished in limits; never filesystem/capture date.

events.title: Preload analysis bounds switch feel
events.summary: The analysis follows the hidden tolerance loop and warns that preload can approach actuation travel. Insert control and O-ring compression remain important assumptions. Credit: Colin Davis, Function Engineering.
events.date_basis: Document/report/message or stated event date, distinguished in limits; never filesystem/capture date.

events.title: Later tactile-criterion proposal
events.summary: Issue notes attribute a proposed 10% initial and greater-than-7% final tactile criterion to Erik; a later summary records a pass beside it. The records do not establish one consistently approved criterion or erase the earlier overall failure. Credit: Erik proposal; FIH record.

verification.scope: Exact existing reader event wording, order, date precision and credit; visualization adds no factual claim. Unknown dates remain unknown.
